annotations.text:
One pitch slide for new deals and existing engagements.
Light palette lifted from the app's own purple theme (#A100FF, #6b21a8, #F1E9FB, #E6D9F5) — the accent chip above the slide flips it to the green theme, text and tints included.
Type: one grotesque family in four weights (Hanken Grotesk), a stand-in for the licensed corporate face, which cannot be loaded here. Swap in the real webfont as an @font-face data URI if you have the files.
The dark version is kept below.
Two alternate directions, sketched. Say the word and I'll build either one out at full fidelity in place of the current slide.
